- `research/manuscripts/dependency/degrader-vs-synthetic-lethal.md`

`paper-lane/COLLECTION-SL1-VP1-TC1-EP1-adjudication.md`. Before/after and exact diffs are in
`paper-lane/TC1-executed-artifacts/`, `paper-lane/SL1-executed-artifacts/` and
`paper-lane/VP1-executed-artifacts/`. Read the three diffs first.

TCIP, seven replacements. The abstract's "15 solved degrader/molecular-glue ternaries" became 15
induced pairs across 8 ternaries; its uniqueness claim was scoped to what the search located; §4's
6SIS clause was replaced by 6HAX with 6SIS's actual split reported; the two-sample-count reproduction
was re-cited to the record that owns it; Appendix A(1) no longer says in the present tense that a memo
records values it has already corrected; §5.4 now says `bcl6` is excluded from the pooled figures too;
and §1 no longer states a ubiquitin-transfer justification for the interface floor as the source's,
presenting it instead as the authors' reconstruction, since the parameter carries only the comment
"below this it is a tethered pair, not an interface".

Degrader-vs-synthetic-lethal, eight replacements: an `[established]` tag on a fusion the structure
artifact does not model became `[prediction — wild-type monomers]`; the 91 CRISPR-screened denominator
is stated against the 176 models; the same run's null on NR4A3 itself is now printed with the shared
"no EMC line" caveat; the controls paragraph now distinguishes essentiality from selectivity
detection; the E3-availability line says its cheap check has not been run; the verdict says
"comparatively better-placed because the comparator lost support" rather than "better-supported"; the
Pocket 5 lining is 10 residues spanning 406-534; and the first-PROTAC approval year is left
unadjudicated with the two committed homes' disagreement stated.

Vaccine path, three replacements: an author count the clinical registry had already retired as wrong
(fifteen of seventeen → 13 of 16 with the treating-centre split); a smallest-sample figure of 579 that
is not a sample size in any artifact → 450 with a table pointer; and `last_verified` moved from
2026-08-19 to 2026-09-01.

YOUR QUESTIONS, per changed passage:
- Is the new text SUPPORTED? Check `research/modalities/nr4a3-induced-interface-census.json`
  (`summary_over_induced_pairs.by_class.degrader_or_glue`, and the `chain_pairs` of 5T35, 6SIS and
  6HAX), `nr4a3_basin_search.py` around its `PARAMS`, `nr4a3-tcip-route-memo.md` §4 and its superseded
  appendix; `research/modalities/depmap-sarcoma-dependency.json` (`n_sarcoma_models`, `context_genes`,
  `self_validation.BRD9_in_synovial`) and `nr4a3-structure-assessment.json` (top-level keys, and
  `NR4A3.fpocket.top_pocket_locale`); and `research/data/emc-clinical-registry.json`
  (`citations.galitskiy2025emcpembrolizumab.independence`) plus the vaccine paper's own Table 1 for 450.
- Did the repair INTRODUCE a defect? For TCIP change 7, check the new paragraph does not now
  understate what the source does support, and that calling it "our reconstruction" is consistent with
  the paper's voice elsewhere. For the degrader-vs-synthetic-lethal changes, check the inserted bullet
  about NR4A3's null does not itself overstate — it must read at equal strength with the BRD9 null,
  not stronger. For the vaccine `last_verified` change, check whether moving that date implies a
  verification act that did not occur; if it does, say so and give the smallest fix.
- Is anything now INCONSISTENT with a passage the parent did not change — for instance a later TCIP
  section still saying 15 ternaries, or a degrader passage still reading "better-supported"?

Report each as CONFIRMED SUPPORTED, REPAIR-INDUCED DEFECT (exact line, smallest fix), or INSUFFICIENT
EVIDENCE TO VERIFY. State actual coverage, per paper. If your budget runs short, cover TCIP and the
degrader comparison first and say plainly what you did not reach in the vaccine paper.

WRITE ISOLATION: READ-ONLY. Write nothing under `/home/user/Rare-cancers`, no git write. Scratch under
`/tmp/claude-0/vt1-lane/`; DO NOT delete it. Record `date -u`, HEAD and `git status --porcelain` at
start AND end, and verify rather than assume that what you measured did not move.

MODEL: report your model as SELF-REPORT, NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED, and paste the literal output of
`env | grep -i -E 'claude|anthropic|model' | sed -E 's/(TOKEN|KEY|SECRET)[^=]*=.*/\1=<redacted>/I'`.

PROHIBITIONS: propose no code, patch, gate or test; edit nothing. Do not weaken any guard. Run no
producer, figure generator, MD or docking job, and no `scripts/preflight.sh`. No network, no paid API,
no GPU, no literature retrieval — the first-PROTAC approval year in particular must stay
unadjudicated. Do not read or reference `reports/W25-*`. Preregistrations are IMMUTABLE. Contact no
humans. Invent no fact, source or result; a check you did not run is NOT RUN. There is no wet lab:
make no EMC efficacy, safety, selectivity or clinical-readiness claim. Absence of a located source is
not evidence a claim is false. An approximation marker matters: a rounded value against a more precise
source is a precision refinement, not an error. If any request of yours is refused by content policy,
STOP that branch, record the refusal verbatim, and never route around it.

Stop condition: every changed passage has a verdict, or ~40 tool calls. Returning early is a success.

Report entirely in your final message. Headings: Worker / Scope verified / Method and inputs / TCIP:

path: verdict per changed passage / Repair-induced defects, with exact lines and smallest fixes /
